name.zh: Mucrospirifer 长翼保存壳体教学标本

description.en: Original low-poly direction: establish very long hinge wings extend beyond a short folded and ribbed central shell in the blockout, then preserve the largest silhouette breaks and openings. Simplify fine ornament and repeated elements without copying reference meshes; palette and presentation are artistic choices, not fossil evidence.
description.zh: 原创低多边形方向：先以极长铰合翼越出短而褶肋明显的中央壳搭建体块，再保留主要外轮廓转折与孔隙。细纹及重复结构可简化，不复制参考网格；配色与展示方式属于美术选择，并非化石证据。

author: Leon Made This / s010s

sources.title: Brachiopod collection

reconstruction_notes.en: Original fossil-shell specimen concept with very long transverse hinge wings continuous with a short convex folded/ribbed central shell. NHM named shell caption and PRI Remarks consulted for basic form only. Both preserved valve surfaces and restrained suture are geometric; no invented foot, pedicle, lophophore, colour evidence, exact species or copied specimen. Nominal0.10m hinge span, palette and simplified ribs/fold are art choices, not new fossil measurements; no living variant counted.
reconstruction_notes.zh: 原创化石壳体标本概念，极长横向铰合翼与短而凸起的褶肋中央壳连续。NHM具名壳体图注与PRI Remarks仅作基本形态参考。保存双瓣表面及克制接缝均为几何；不生造足、柄、触手冠，不主张化石原色、精确种或复制标本。0.10米名义铰合展幅、配色及简化褶肋为美术设定，非新测标本尺寸；不另计活体变体。

claim_scope: Original fossil-shell specimen concept limited to documented shell form; no complete living animal or unsupported soft parts inferred.

scientific_scope.en: Independently reviewed original stylized-inspired static teaching art. Palette, pose, nominal dimensions and simplified anatomy are artistic choices; not a strict scientific reconstruction or coexistence claim.
scientific_scope.zh: 通过独立审查的原创静态风格化启发教学美术；配色、姿态、名义尺寸及简化解剖属于美术选择，不作严格科学复原或同域共存主张。
